quizDescription: A friendly psychometric test that explores how you like to learn, think, and what interests you.

items.content: I enjoy solving number puzzles and brain teasers.
I like figuring out how things work by thinking step by step.
Maths problems are fun for me to solve.
I notice patterns in numbers and shapes quickly.
I often hum, sing, or tap out rhythms.
I can remember tunes after hearing them once or twice.
I enjoy listening to and making music.
I notice when a note or a beat sounds wrong.
I like watching animals, plants, and insects.
I enjoy spending time outdoors in nature.
I can tell different kinds of plants or animals apart.
I like collecting things like rocks, leaves, or shells.
I enjoy reading stories and books.
I like telling stories or making up my own.
Playing with words is fun for me.
I learn new words easily.
I make friends easily.
I can tell how my friends are feeling.
I like working together in a group.
Other people often come to me for help.
I like sports, dancing, or moving around.
I learn best by doing things with my hands.
I am good at building or making things.
Sitting still for a long time is hard for me.
I like drawing, painting, or making models.
I can picture things clearly in my mind.
I am good at puzzles like mazes and jigsaws.
I can find my way around new places easily.
I know what I am good at and what I find hard.
I like spending some quiet time on my own to think.
I understand my own feelings.
I set goals for myself.
I ask big questions about life and the world.
I often wonder why things exist.
I think about things we cannot see or fully explain.
I like talking about what things really mean.
I like fixing or building things with tools.
I enjoy working outdoors.
I like taking things apart to see how they work.
I would rather make something than read about it.
I like doing experiments to find things out.
I ask a lot of 'why' and 'how' questions.
I enjoy figuring out why things happen.
Science interests me.
I like making art, music, or stories.
I enjoy using my imagination.
I like to express myself in creative ways.
I would enjoy designing or decorating things.
I like helping other people.
I enjoy teaching or explaining things to others.
I care about how others feel.
I like taking care of people or animals.
I like being the leader of a group.
I enjoy convincing others about my ideas.
I like starting new projects or clubs.
I am comfortable speaking in front of others.
I like keeping my things neat and organised.
I enjoy following clear steps and rules.
I like working with numbers and lists.
I am careful and tidy with my work.
